newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE may become unstable from 4,910.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE may become unstable from 4,910.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will extend recent gains to hover near the 4,910 level on Wednesday, technical analysts said.
Bank and pharmaceutical shares are expected to play a prominent role in leading the market up and may become increasingly unsteady the further it ventures above 4,900, they added.

Its progress up today follows on from a chart breakout on Tuesday from a bullish descending wedge pattern composed of a pair of converging trendlines connecting the highs and lows since late last week.
Maximum width of the pattern -- of just over 30 points -- when added to the point of breakout at 4,875 gives a target near 4,910.

The FTSE's advance/decline ratio has been roughly even over the past two days but the short-term bullish bias following the chart breakout should ensure that a more positive ratio is registered today, analysts said.
By 0748 GMT, the FTSE was up 32.0 at 4,908.6 and the number of advancing stocks to declining was 10-to-one.
